# Alejololer: Carlos Alejandro Alemán Osorio

> Software Engineer based in Quito, Ecuador. Builds production web products with Python/Django, TypeScript/Next.js, Astro and LLMs, and builds fast, search-optimized websites (SEO, GEO, AEO) for small businesses in Ecuador.

Carlos Alejandro Alemán Osorio (online: Alejololer) works at Upstart 13 building production features with Django and Next.js, including LLM integrations on the OpenAI API that extract structured data from unstructured client documents and cut document drafting from days to hours. He holds a B.Eng. in Software Engineering from Escuela Politécnica Nacional (Quito, graduation grade 28/30) and the Microsoft Certified: Azure Administrator Associate (AZ-104) certification. Previously he was a Software Developer at Sagat Farm, where he was named Best Intern of the Cycle. He speaks Spanish (native) and English (professional).

## Freelance work
- Builds custom-designed websites for local businesses in Ecuador with Astro or Next.js, hosted on Vercel.
- Focus on local SEO, GEO (generative engine optimization: being cited by AI assistants such as ChatGPT, Gemini and Perplexity) and AEO (answer engine optimization: FAQ content with structured data).
- Contact: acarlosaleman03@gmail.com

## Websites built
- [Virtus Estudio Jurídico](https://virtusestudiojuridico.com): multidisciplinary law firm in Salcedo, Cotopaxi. Ranks top 3 on Google for "abogados Salcedo". Includes a free child-support calculator with PDF output.
- [Asia Motors Importadora](https://asia-motors-eta.vercel.app): official importer of Skyworth, Kenbo, 212 and FAW vehicles in Ecuador. Catalog, EV savings calculator, test drive booking and quotes.
- [Con Cariño](https://con-carino.vercel.app): gift shop in Latacunga. Catalog and cart that sends orders to WhatsApp, with an admin panel.

## Open source
- [usdx-autochart](https://github.com/Alejololer/usdx-autochart): generates UltraStar Deluxe karaoke charts from audio.
- [shop-base](https://github.com/Alejololer/shop-base): reusable storefront + CMS template (Astro, Neon, WhatsApp checkout).
- [TripTikBot](https://github.com/Alejololer/TripTikBot): AI agent for finding travel experiences.
